description: This source file provides utility functions for handling IPv4 addresses, including range assertions, bit counting, conversions between dotted notation and integers, subnet calculations, and address type validations such as RFC1918, loopback, multicast, and others.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Checks whether input is a valid unsigned 32-bit integer within range 0 to 4294967295.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Calculates and exports the number of bits set in a given unsigned 32-bit integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts a dotted-quad string IP address into its integer representation, validating format and octet ranges.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts an integer IP address back into the dotted-quad string format.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts a prefix length (e.g., 24) into its corresponding subnet mask in integer form.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if a netmask or bitmask is contiguous (i.e., has contiguous '1's).

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts a netmask to prefix length if it is contiguous, validating the mask's correctness.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Determines if an IP address falls within RFC1918 private address ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks if an IP address matches DHCP link-local addresses (RFC3927).

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Verifies if an IP address is a loopback address (127.0.0.0/8).

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within the multicast address range (224.0.0.0/4).
